title: Agents
subtitle: Create new agents so different legal workflows can use separate personas and workspaces.

createDialog.description: Create a new agent by name. You can optionally inherit the LawClaw main agent workspace bootstrap files.

deleteDialog.title: Delete Agent

settingsDialog.channelsManagedInChannels: This agent is linked to channel types. Manage exact account bindings in the Channels page.
